card.intended_use: Decision support for research and teaching: multi-finding probabilities on chest radiographs (PA/AP). Not a diagnosis.
card.training_data: TorchXRayVision DenseNet-121 'all' weights, trained on a union of public chest radiograph datasets. The exact union and labels are defined by the upstream project.
card.validation: No validation on Ugandan or local patients. Upstream public-dataset performance only; no local benchmark has been run.
limitations: Trained on non-African populations; performance may not transfer.
Labels are dataset annotations, not confirmed diagnoses.
Portable or scanned films and unusual windowing may degrade results.
The heatmap shows where the model looked, not proof of a finding.

card.intended_use: Demonstration only. Exercises the pipeline without an ML model.
card.training_data: None. Deterministic function of image statistics.
limitations: Must be labelled demo in every result.
